task: R16 Task A: Trie-only GCD-equivalent baseline (4 configs)
constraint_type: trie-only (vocabulary membership, no JSON structure enforcement)
key_findings: Trie eliminates ET/RV (0% across all configs) — vocabulary constraint itself works correctly
Trie cannot eliminate DR (15.2-95.5%) — without JSON structure enforcement, model omits type fields or produces broken JSON
OntoCoDec S1 eliminates DR to 0-0.93% — grammar layer provides necessary JSON structure
DR gap (15-95pp) = grammar layer's contribution, definitively proving enabling dependency
Llama FT trie has 50.8% parse failure — trie constraints interfere with JSON token generation, further evidence vocabulary-only is insufficient
Qwen FT trie DR=95.5% (highest) because FT model produces more relations, more opportunities for DR violation
mf1_response: GCD-equivalent vocabulary-only constraints cannot replace OntoCoDec's two-layer approach. Vocabulary constraints eliminate ET/RV but leave DR unconstrained (15-95%). The grammar layer (JSON structure enforcement) is a prerequisite for vocabulary membership constraints to achieve full schema compliance.
